name: Paint calculator
shortDescription: Estimate paint liters and cans for walls or a manual area.
longDescription: Use this paint calculator to estimate paint quantity from area, coats, coverage and can size.
seoTitle: Paint calculator — liters and cans needed
seoDescription: Calculate paint liters and cans for walls using area, coats, coverage and can volume.
howToUse: Set coats, coverage and can size.
howItWorks: The calculator multiplies area by coats and coverage, then divides by can volume.
example: Estimate paint for 30 square meters with two coats.

faq.q: How accurate is this paint calculator?
faq.a: The result is a practical estimate based on the values you enter and the formula shown on the page.

faq.q: Does this paint calculator require an account?
faq.a: No. The calculator works in your browser and does not require registration.

faq.q: Can I share a paint calculator result?
faq.a: Yes. Use the share link to copy the current inputs in the page URL.

disclaimer: Results are reference estimates. Verify the inputs before making important decisions.
